reviewed_stories.title: PIBTL rebounds to Rs3.4bn profit in FY26
reviewed_stories.linkage_detail: Direct earnings event for Pakistan International Bulk Terminal Limited (PSX: PIBTL), whose identity and FY26 figures are verified on the official PSX company page.
reviewed_stories.reason: FY26 net profit reached Rs3.37bn versus a Rs257.93m loss in FY25. Revenue rose 64%, gross profit rose 165% and finance cost fell 43%, establishing a material direct improvement in reported earnings.
